# gitmoap_group_sso_invites (Data Source)

List the organization's pending single sign-on invites. Ordered by email address. Only the organization's owners can read it.

The token needs `sso:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The organization's top-level group

### Read-Only

- `invites` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invites))

<a id="nestedatt--invites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invites`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether that time has passed: the invite admits nobody, and inviting the address again
replaces it.
- `expires_at` (String) When the invite stops letting the address in; absent for one that waits until used.
- `invited_by` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invites--invited_by))
- `reason` (String)
- `role` (Attributes) A role — built in or defined by the organization — with its display name and the built-in rank
it counts as. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invites--role))

<a id="nestedatt--invites--invited_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invites.invited_by`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The principal's picture, when one is known. Absent otherwise: a client derives the
deterministic avatar URL itself.
- `email` (String) The principal's address. An agent's is a generated no-reply address — the author of its
commits. `unknown` on a deleted actor and empty on a redacted one.
- `id` (String) The principal's id: a user id, a service account id or an agent id, as `kind` says. Empty on
a redacted actor.
- `kind` (String) A person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — which of the three a principal is,
and so which page it links to: a person's profile, a service account's page or an agent's page.
- `username` (String) The name to show: a person's or service account's username, or an agent's handle (which
always ends in `-ai`). `deleted-user` when the actor no longer resolves, `redacted` when the
caller may not see who it was. A closed account whose work stays is `closed-` and twelve hex
digits, a shape no open account may take, with an address under `.invalid`.


<a id="nestedatt--invites--role"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invites.role`

Read-Only:

- `builtin` (String)
- `custom` (String)
- `name` (String) The role's display name: a built-in name such as `Developer`, or the custom role's name.
- `rank` (String)
